name: Krol'dok Moulding
summary: The Krol'dok moulding looks as though it belongs to a key. Someone in Farholde Keep may know more about it.

sections.title: A Key's Mould
sections.body: You have a moulding that appears to be for a key. Someone in Farholde Keep may know what the mould is for, and you bring it to them to learn more.

faq.answer: The Krol'dok moulding appears to be for a key.

faq.q: Who might know about the mould?
faq.answer: Someone in Farholde Keep may know about the mould.

faq.q: What happens when I bring the moulding?
faq.answer: The person you bring it to says they will see what can be done with it.
